datasheet_identity.title: MM1Z2V0B THRU MM1Z75B SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES (SOD-123 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes)

extraction_notes: The MM1Z47B row gives VZ min/nom/max = 46.06/47.0/47.94 V at IZT = 2.5 mA; ZZT maximum 150 ohm at IZT; IR maximum 2 microA at VR = 36 V (p. 2).
The p. 3 zener-characteristics plots label traces only through 33B; no MM1Z47B-specific trace is plotted, so neighboring curves are not borrowed.
No per-part capacitance or reverse-recovery time is published for this part.
extraction.omission_reason: No usable MM1Z47B-specific curve is published: the p. 3 family zener plots label curves only through 33B, not 47B, so assigning a neighboring trace would invent evidence.
